g.text: Observed study changes against the fitted trajectory

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Each black segment spans one study's age window; its rise or fall is that study's observed change, anchored to the fitted curve at its baseline age.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Adult-baseline raw longitudinal samples only — 9 samples from 7 cohorts, no retest adjustment. Shaded band = 95% CI. Coloured dot = fitted peak.
